transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because I'm having some trouble at work lately. I supervise a retail team, and when I try to explain things to them—like the inventory numbers or the weekend schedule—my words just start jumping around. 

I'll start out talking about the delivery trucks, and then somehow I'm talking about Thursdays, or... or the church grill, or my boss's tone of voice. I don't really mean to do it, but people just look at me like they can't follow what I'm saying at all. It's making it pretty hard to do my job.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people do not?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. It's really just the trouble with my words getting all mixed up when I try to talk to my team.
Have you been feeling unusually energized or more upbeat than usual lately?

No, not really. I mean, I haven't felt overly energetic or anything like that. I mostly just feel... well, pretty frustrated and stressed out with how things are going at the store. But definitely not upbeat.
Have you had any recent head injury, stroke, or other medical problem before these speech changes started?

No, nothing like that. I haven't hit my head or been in the hospital for anything. I've been pretty healthy, honestly, aside from all this... this trouble with my words. So, no strokes or injuries that I know of.
Have you been having any strong beliefs that other people think are unusual or not true?

No, I don't think so. I mean, nobody's told me I'm saying anything strange or unbelievable. It's just... the words themselves. They just don't come out right. But my thoughts and beliefs, those are all normal. Just the usual stuff.
When your speech gets mixed up, are you also finding it hard to keep your thoughts organized?

Yeah, I suppose that's exactly it. That's actually why I came in to see you. When I try to explain things at work, like the inventory numbers or the weekend schedule, my words just start jumping all over the place. I'll go from talking about the delivery trucks, to Thursdays, to the church grill, and then to my boss’s tone of voice. And my team just looks at me like they can’t follow what I’m saying at all. It's like I just can't keep the thoughts lined up straight before they come out of my mouth.
When did you first start noticing this trouble with your speech?

I'd say it's been... about six months now. That's when it really started getting noticeable out on the sales floor. I'd be giving these jumbled explanations to my team, or just making these odd stops right in the middle of talking. So yeah, roughly six months.
